name: Night Haze Castle
source:
Welcome to  NIGHT HAZE CASTLE,  a kinky visual novel about an unfortunate pony running from debts and stumbling upon a mysterious castle and it's cunning mistress  - Lunar Lace.

[From [url=https://lunarlace.itch.io/night-haze-castle]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《NIGHT HAZE CASTLE》，这是一部古怪的视觉小说，讲述了一匹不幸的小马为摆脱债务而逃跑，并偶然发现一座神秘城堡和它狡猾的情妇 - 月亮蕾丝。

[来自[url=https://lunarlace.itch.io/night-haze-castle]Itch.io[/url]]
